beats.vo: [Inter] are top of [Serie A]. Their own coach called it luck.

lines: Siamo stati fortunati oggi nel portarla a casa
sub: — WE WERE LUCKY TODAY TO BRING IT HOME
CHIVU · TOP WITH 25 POINTS FROM NINE
beats.vo: [Chivu] told [Sky Sport Italia] they were lucky to bring it home. Twenty-five points from nine.

sub: THE TABLE DOES NOT ASK HOW
beats.vo: Winning ugly in October is still winning. The table does not ask how.

sub: NO TALKS SINCE SEPTEMBER · DEAL TO 2027
beats.vo: [La Gazzetta dello Sport] says talks over [Federico Dimarco]'s new deal have not moved since September.
The derby is Saturday at three forty-five Eastern.
